intro: A review of B1 resources for checking sources, summarising information, explaining procedures, recounting experiences and supporting conclusions.

pregunta.texto: Ch. 31. What does «o obiecție plauzibilă» mean?

opciones.texto: A plausible objection.
opciones.explicacion: «Plauzibilă» agrees with the feminine «obiecție».

opciones.texto: A demonstrated conclusion.
opciones.explicacion: An objection is a contrary position, not a conclusion.

opciones.texto: An independent source.
opciones.explicacion: That would be «sursă independentă».

frase.texto: Cap. 31. O dovadă credibilă susține ideea.

opciones.texto: A credible proof supports the idea.
opciones.explicacion: «Dovadă» is proof and «susține» expresses support.

opciones.texto: A plausible idea contradicts all the data.
opciones.explicacion: It changes the meaning.

opciones.texto: The objection proves that the source does not exist.
opciones.explicacion: That is not what the sentence says.

pregunta.texto: Ch. 31. Complete «The argument is plausible, but not convincing».

opciones.texto: plauzibil
opciones.explicacion: It agrees in the masculine with «argumentul».

opciones.texto: plauzibilă
opciones.explicacion: It is the feminine form.

opciones.texto: nuanțată
opciones.explicacion: It is feminine and means «nuanced».

pregunta.texto: Ch. 32. Which formula expresses a formal and polite request?

opciones.texto: Aș dori.
opciones.explicacion: It means «I would like» and softens the request.

opciones.texto: Refuzul.
opciones.explicacion: It means «the refusal».

opciones.texto: Defectul.
opciones.explicacion: It means «the defect».

frase.texto: Cap. 32. Aș dori să depun reclamația în scris.

opciones.texto: I would like to submit the complaint in writing.
opciones.explicacion: The request is polite and formal.

opciones.texto: I reject the complaint because the product works.
opciones.explicacion: It changes the purpose.

opciones.texto: The delivery deadline is written on the receipt.
opciones.explicacion: That is not the translated sentence.

pregunta.texto: Ch. 33. What is the difference between «mă doare capul» and «mă dor ochii»?

opciones.texto: The verb agrees: singular with «capul» and plural with «ochii».
opciones.explicacion: In Romanian, the number of the noun affects the verb form.

opciones.texto: «Mă doare» is only used to describe a medical appointment.
opciones.explicacion: It expresses physical pain.

opciones.texto: There is no difference; both sentences have the same plural subject.
opciones.explicacion: The nouns are in different numbers.

frase.texto: Cap. 33. Ați putea să-mi explicați procedura înainte de recoltare?

opciones.texto: Could you explain the procedure to me before the sample collection?
opciones.explicacion: It is a formal request for clarification.

opciones.texto: Could they cancel the results after the analysis?
opciones.explicacion: It changes the actions.

opciones.texto: The preparation is necessary for two weeks.
opciones.explicacion: That is not the translated sentence.

opciones.texto: In progress.
opciones.explicacion: It describes an activity that is still continuing.

opciones.texto: Finished.
opciones.explicacion: «Finalizat» expresses that it has finished.

opciones.texto: Postponed.
opciones.explicacion: «Amânat» means «postponed».

frase.texto: Cap. 34. În urma ședinței, transmitem participanților procesul-verbal.

opciones.texto: Following the meeting, we send the minutes to the participants.
opciones.explicacion: «Procesul-verbal» is the minutes of the meeting.

opciones.texto: Before the meeting, we changed the delivery deadline.
opciones.explicacion: It does not match the sentence.

opciones.texto: The client takes charge of the project.
opciones.explicacion: That is another expression.

pregunta.texto: Ch. 35. What does a synthesis of several sources do?

opciones.texto: It integrates its ideas and keeps the relevant differences.
opciones.explicacion: It summarises without confusing the positions.

opciones.texto: It copies all the texts without relating them.
opciones.explicacion: That is not synthesising.

opciones.texto: It presents its own opinion as a quotation from the source.
opciones.explicacion: A synthesis attributes each idea.

frase.texto: Cap. 35. Punctele comune sunt ușor de identificat.

opciones.texto: The points in common are easy to identify.
opciones.explicacion: «Punctele comune» points out the coincidences.

opciones.texto: The interpretation changes every paragraph of the report.
opciones.explicacion: It is not the sentence.

opciones.texto: The conclusion omits all the sources.
opciones.explicacion: The sentence does not say it.

pregunta.texto: Ch. 36. What does «în schimb» mean when describing transport alternatives?

opciones.texto: Instead.
opciones.explicacion: It presents another option or compensation.

opciones.texto: Despite the distance.
opciones.explicacion: That idea is expressed with «în ciuda».

opciones.texto: According to some sources.
opciones.explicacion: That is a news attribution.

frase.texto: Cap. 36. Fațada a fost restaurată cu atenție.

opciones.texto: The façade was restored carefully.
opciones.explicacion: The participle agrees in the feminine with «fațada».

opciones.texto: The guide will restore the monument tomorrow.
opciones.explicacion: It changes the tense and the subject.

opciones.texto: The square represents the history of the building.
opciones.explicacion: It is not the translation.

pregunta.texto: Ch. 37. In a news story, what can «ar fi fost amânată» signal?

opciones.texto: That the meeting would have been postponed according to a source, without confirmation from the outlet.
opciones.explicacion: The conditional can mark distance from the fact.

opciones.texto: An order to postpone the meeting.
opciones.explicacion: It is not an imperative form.

opciones.texto: That the meeting is postponed every week.
opciones.explicacion: It does not express a habitual action.

frase.texto: Cap. 37. Înainte de a distribui o știre, verifică sursa și data publicării.

opciones.texto: Before sharing a news story, check the source and the date of publication.
opciones.explicacion: It recommends checking the data before sharing.

opciones.texto: After sharing it, check who wrote the medical report.
opciones.explicacion: It changes the sequence and the topic.

opciones.texto: The source published a date that cannot be checked.
opciones.explicacion: It is not the content of the sentence.

pregunta.texto: Ch. 37. What does «potrivit unor surse» add?

opciones.texto: It attributes the fact to some sources and does not amount to confirming it.
opciones.explicacion: It indicates where the information comes from.

opciones.texto: It guarantees that the outlet has personally verified the fact.
opciones.explicacion: Attribution is not a verification.

opciones.texto: It presents a condition for restarting an appliance.
opciones.explicacion: It does not deal with technical instructions.

frase.texto: Cap. 38. Nu scoateți capacul cât timp aparatul este conectat.

opciones.texto: Do not remove the lid while the appliance is connected.
opciones.explicacion: It is a formal safety instruction.

opciones.texto: Disconnect the appliance and remove the lid immediately.
opciones.explicacion: The sentence forbids removing the lid while it is connected.

opciones.texto: The indicator light must come on after restarting.
opciones.explicacion: That is not the translated sentence.

pregunta.texto: Ch. 38. What does «cu excepția cazului în care» mean?

opciones.texto: Unless.
opciones.explicacion: It introduces an exception to the rule.

opciones.texto: Because.
opciones.explicacion: It expresses cause.

opciones.texto: As for.
opciones.explicacion: It introduces a topic.

pregunta.texto: Ch. 39. What does «pe când locuiam» add to the story?

opciones.texto: It places an action in progress in the background in the past.
opciones.explicacion: The imperfect sets the context.

opciones.texto: It presents an order addressed to the reader.
opciones.explicacion: It is not an imperative form.

opciones.texto: It indicates that the action will happen in the future.
opciones.explicacion: It is in the past.

frase.texto: Cap. 39. Ar merita să comparăm ofertele în funcție de buget.

opciones.texto: It would be worth comparing the offers depending on the budget.
opciones.explicacion: The conditional softens the recommendation.

opciones.texto: We compare the receipts after the deadline.
opciones.explicacion: It changes the action and the tense.

opciones.texto: The first offer is more expensive and has no warranty.
opciones.explicacion: It is not the translated sentence.

frase.texto: Cap. 39. Finalul oferă o interpretare neașteptată a temei centrale.

opciones.texto: The ending offers an unexpected interpretation of the central theme.
opciones.explicacion: The sentence describes an assessment of the work.

opciones.texto: The novel reveals the error code after restarting.
opciones.explicacion: It mixes another topic.

opciones.texto: The characters change perspective before the public consultation.
opciones.explicacion: It does not match the content.

opciones.texto: A formal request: "could you / could they?".
opciones.explicacion: It expresses a possibility with politeness.

opciones.texto: A direct order to deliver something.
opciones.explicacion: For an order the imperative would be used.

opciones.texto: A definitive refusal of the request.
opciones.explicacion: It is not the meaning of the expression.

pregunta.texto: Ch. 33. What does «de o săptămână» add when describing a symptom?

opciones.texto: It indicates it has been a week.
opciones.explicacion: It specifies how long it lasts.

opciones.texto: It indicates that it appears only at night.
opciones.explicacion: That is expressed with «în timpul nopții».

opciones.texto: It indicates that the symptom improves after effort.
opciones.explicacion: It is not a duration.

pregunta.texto: Ch. 34. What is a «proces-verbal» used for after a meeting?

opciones.texto: To record the agreements and decisions.
opciones.explicacion: It records what was discussed in the session.

opciones.texto: To request a medical appointment.
opciones.explicacion: It is another type of procedure.

opciones.texto: To confirm the receipt for a product.
opciones.explicacion: It does not record a meeting.

opciones.texto: The introduction announces the main idea.
opciones.explicacion: It presents the central topic of the report.

opciones.texto: Each paragraph develops a different argument.
opciones.explicacion: It is another function of the text.

opciones.texto: The conclusion summarises the sources without repeating the text.
opciones.explicacion: It is not the translation of this sentence.

piezas.traduccion: The introduction announces the main idea.
